reflectors.description:
AETHER HELLAS is an experimental Greek NXDN digital voice project.

Initiated and currently operated by a licensed radio amateur,
it openly invites fellow system operators to interconnect and collaborate,
as well as licensed radio amateurs to connect via hotspots
for testing, experimentation and on-air communication.

What is "Aether Hellas"?

In Greek Mythology, Aether was the personification of the upper air breathed by the Gods. In early physics, it was believed to be the medium that fills the universe, allowing waves to propagate through space.
For us, Aether Hellas represents the "invisible web" that connects Greece to the world. It is our digital gateway that transforms the air into communication, bridging the distances between Rhodes, Thessaly, and Central Greece, uniting people and technology under a shared amateur radio vision.
reflectors.name: GR-AETHER-HELLAS-NXDN

reflectors.description: Loughton and Epping Forest Amateur Radio Society - LEFARS

The Extended Freedom Network is a Multimode Amateur Radio Network allowing a diverse range of Amateur Operators to come together via different and normally incompatible modes, with connections spanning the globe to bring people together making those QSO's happen.

You can connect to the Extended Freedom Network via a number of ways. Our primary route is via the Allstar system, node no’s. 2195 & 2197.

We have connectivity using EchoLink, DMR, Yaesu Fusion (YSF), Teamspeak, Hamshack Hotline and our own VoIP Network Extended Freedom SIP.

Murphy Radio Network (MRN)
Website: http://murphy-radio.net/
Location: North Central Texas
 
The Murphy Radio Network (MRN) is an expanding amateur radio group dedicated to fostering an open, experimental environment for operators in North Central Texas and beyond. Believing that ham radio thrives on variety, our infrastructure seamlessly integrates both analog and digital modes.
 
MRN operates on a simple philosophy: total freedom to use, experiment, and connect. As long as your operations align with FCC Part 97 licensing regulations, our network is your playground. Whether you are an experienced Elmer or a newly licensed tech looking to experiment with new modes, you will find a welcoming home here. Come join the fun and help us grow the network!
